thigh.definition: The upper part of the leg between the hip and the knee.
thigh.exampleUsage: The thigh contains the strongest bone and muscles in the body.

quadricep.definition: The large four-part muscle group located at the front of the thigh.
quadricep.exampleUsage: The quadricep straightens the leg at the knee joint.

hamstring.definition: The muscle group running along the posterior side of the thigh.
hamstring.exampleUsage: The hamstring flexes the knee and helps extend the hip.

hip-joint.definition: The ball-and-socket joint linking the femur head to the pelvis.
hip-joint.exampleUsage: The hip joint supports body weight during standing and walking.

groin.definition: The anatomical junction between the lower abdomen and the thigh.
groin.exampleUsage: The groin marks the fold between the abdomen and thigh.

inner-thigh.definition: The medial surface of the thigh facing inward.
inner-thigh.exampleUsage: The inner thigh muscles draw the leg inward.

outer-thigh.definition: The lateral exterior surface of the thigh facing outward.
outer-thigh.exampleUsage: The outer thigh muscles help stabilize the pelvis during motion.

femur.definition: The thigh bone, the longest and strongest bone in the human skeleton.
femur.exampleUsage: The femur extends from the hip joint to the knee.

hip-flexor.definition: A group of muscles that pull the thigh upward toward the pelvis.
hip-flexor.exampleUsage: A hip flexor lifts the leg forward during each step.

iliac-crest.definition: The curved upper ridge of the ilium bone of the pelvis.
iliac-crest.exampleUsage: The iliac crest forms the prominent upper border of the hip bone.

knee.definition: The major hinge joint between the thigh and the lower leg.
knee.exampleUsage: The knee bends as the runner pushes off the ground.

kneecap.definition: The small movable bone protecting the front of the knee; patella.
kneecap.exampleUsage: The kneecap shields the front of the knee joint.

shin.definition: The front anterior edge of the lower leg along the tibia bone.
shin.exampleUsage: A protective guard covers the shin in football.

calf.definition: The fleshy muscular back part of the lower leg below the knee.
calf.exampleUsage: The calf muscles help push the foot down during a stride.

tibia.definition: The larger, weight-bearing inner bone of the lower leg; shinbone.
tibia.exampleUsage: The tibia carries the primary load between knee and ankle.

fibula.definition: The slender outer bone of the lower leg alongside the tibia.
fibula.exampleUsage: The fibula runs parallel to the tibia on the outer leg.

achilles-tendon.definition: The large tendon connecting the calf muscles to the heel bone.
achilles-tendon.exampleUsage: The Achilles tendon transmits force from the calf to the heel.

popliteal.definition: Relating to or located in the hollow area behind the knee joint.
popliteal.exampleUsage: The popliteal space lies directly behind the knee.

meniscus.definition: A crescent-shaped cartilage pad cushioning the knee joint bones.
meniscus.exampleUsage: The meniscus cushions impact between femur and tibia.

ligament.definition: A band of tough fibrous tissue connecting bones across a joint.
ligament.exampleUsage: A ligament provides structural stability to the knee joint.

foot.definition: The terminal part of the lower limb below the ankle joint.
foot.exampleUsage: The foot supports the entire weight of an upright person.

ankle.definition: The joint connecting the lower leg with the foot.
ankle.exampleUsage: The ankle pivots to allow the foot to flex and point.

heel.definition: The rounded posterior bottom portion of the human foot.
heel.exampleUsage: The heel strikes the ground first in a typical walking stride.

sole.definition: The plantar underside surface of the foot.
sole.exampleUsage: The sole of the foot rests flat upon the floor.

arch.definition: The curved upward structure along the bottom of the foot.
arch.exampleUsage: The arch of the foot absorbs shock with every step.

instep.definition: The arched upper surface of the foot between toes and ankle.
instep.exampleUsage: The shoe laces fasten across the instep of the foot.

ball-of-foot.definition: The padded cushioned area on the sole just behind the toes.
ball-of-foot.exampleUsage: He pivoted smoothly on the ball of his foot.

ankle-bone.definition: The prominent bony projection on either side of the ankle joint.
ankle-bone.exampleUsage: The ankle bone is visible on either side of the foot.

plantar.definition: Relating to the bottom sole surface of the human foot.
plantar.exampleUsage: Plantar refers to the underside surface of the foot.

metatarsal.definition: One of the five long bones forming the midfoot and arch.
metatarsal.exampleUsage: Each metatarsal bone connects the ankle to a toe digit.

big-toe.definition: The innermost, largest digit of the human foot.
big-toe.exampleUsage: The big toe provides push-off leverage during walking.

little-toe.definition: The smallest, outermost digit of the human foot.
little-toe.exampleUsage: The little toe is the fifth and smallest toe on the foot.

toenail.definition: The hard protective keratin plate covering the top of each toe tip.
toenail.exampleUsage: A healthy toenail shields the sensitive toe tip.

toe-pad.definition: The cushioned fleshy underside at the tip of each toe.
toe-pad.exampleUsage: The toe pad grips the floor lightly during balance.

toe-joint.definition: An articulating joint between the small bones of a toe.
toe-joint.exampleUsage: A toe joint allows flexible bending of the digit.

bunion.definition: A bony swelling that can form at the base joint of the big toe.
bunion.exampleUsage: A bunion may develop from pressure on the toe joint.

callus.definition: A thickened area of skin resulting from repeated friction or rubbing.
callus.exampleUsage: A small callus formed on the side of his foot from tight shoes.

blister.definition: A small fluid-filled pocket on the skin caused by friction or heat.
blister.exampleUsage: A painful blister developed after hiking in stiff boots.

cuticle.definition: The narrow fold of skin edging the base of a toenail or fingernail.
cuticle.exampleUsage: The cuticle seals the base of the nail against debris.

nail-bed.definition: The sensitive vascular tissue directly beneath the nail plate.
nail-bed.exampleUsage: The nail bed lies beneath the hard nail plate.

walk.definition: To advance forward on foot by taking alternating steps.
walk.exampleUsage: She walked briskly through the park each morning.

run.definition: To move rapidly on foot with a stride where both feet leave the ground.
run.exampleUsage: He ran around the marked circuit to build stamina.

jump.definition: To push off the ground into the air using leg muscle power.
jump.exampleUsage: She jumped over the puddle with a quick leap.

squat.definition: To lower the body by bending the knees while keeping feet on the ground.
squat.exampleUsage: The trainer demonstrated how to squat with a neutral spine.

lunge.definition: To step forward with one leg bent while lowering the rear leg.
lunge.exampleUsage: She stepped into a forward lunge to stretch her legs.

kick.definition: To strike or propel an object forcefully with the foot.
kick.exampleUsage: He kicked the ball toward the net with precision.

kneel.definition: To rest one or both knees upon the floor or a supporting surface.
kneel.exampleUsage: He knelt down on one knee to tie his shoelace.

crouch.definition: To stoop or bend down low with bent knees and forward posture.
crouch.exampleUsage: She crouched down to examine the model on the low table.

stride.definition: To walk forward with long, decisive and measured steps.
stride.exampleUsage: He took long, steady strides down the hallway.

tiptoe.definition: To walk quietly on the balls and tips of the toes.
tiptoe.exampleUsage: She walked on tiptoe to avoid making a sound on the floor.
